topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: As I sit here, watching the minutes tick by on the airport clock, a sense of acceptance washes over me regarding the delay. Despite the frustration that could easily take hold, I find myself more focused on planning the next steps. My flight has been pushed back by a few hours, and it’s clear that missing this event is now inevitable. Still, I take a moment to send a message, informing them of the unfortunate turn. I map out alternative ways to make the most of the day, perhaps catching up on reading or exploring a nearby part of the airport I haven’t seen before. It’s not the outcome I hoped for, but there’s a gentle resolve to make the best of it.
